page: Microsoft Azure NC72ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor providing 72 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 264.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.67 GB of RAM per core.

This server features a single hardware GPU and includes 3960 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server bundles high-capacity local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU resources with a high vCPU count, making it a dense resource allocation for specialized workloads. This hardware profile is suited for GPU-accelerated compute tasks, professional visualization, rendering, machine learning inference, and database workloads requiring fast local scratch space.
